title: Sharḥ Ḥadīth Nabawī

date.basis: The only copy is in MS Majlis 10196 f. 122a and is undated.

manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 f. 122a (the only copy listed); marginal note says copied from an autograph in a majmūʿa of Rukn al-Dīn Ṣāʿid Kirmānī.
summary: A brief mystical commentary on the hadith on the best speech being the Book of God; copied, by a marginal note, from an autograph in a majmūʿa of Rukn al-Dīn Ṣāʿid Kirmānī.
